input.sql:
SELECT c.Currency,
       SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) AS cust_cnt
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY c.Currency

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_diff
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
